definitions.explanation: A fixed, well-established expression — a phrase or idiom whose wording has been stable over time and whose meaning cannot always be predicted from its parts. Often refers to four-character compounds ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) and proverbs drawn from Chinese classics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{成語|せいご}。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{成語|せいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please look up the meaning of this idiom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{成語|せいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: In classical-Chinese class, we learn many set phrases that originate from the Chinese classics.

examples.japanese: 「{温故知新|おんこちしん}」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{論語|ろんご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{成語|せいご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、「⟦{古|ふる}き→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{温|たず}ねて⟦{新|あたら}しき→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧だ。
examples.english: "Onko chishin" is a famous idiom derived from the Analects, meaning "review the old to learn the new."

notes:
Composed of {成|せい} (become, form, complete) and ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (word, phrase). Refers to expressions that have become fixed in the language — idioms, proverbs, and set phrases whose wording is stable and whose meaning is conventional.

USAGE:
In Japanese, {成語|せいご} is especially used for expressions of classical origin, including many Chinese four-character idioms (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) and literary proverbs. It is a somewhat formal or scholarly term; everyday Japanese uses ⟦{慣用句|かんようく}→慣用句：15890_kanyouku⟧ or ことわざ for most idiomatic expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成語|せいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a set phrase
- {成語|せいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引用|いんよう}する→引用する：26928_inyousuru⟧: to quote an idiom
- {成語|せいご}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: a dictionary of set phrases/idioms
- ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧{成語|せいご}: Chinese idioms (chengyu)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{慣用句|かんようく}→慣用句：15890_kanyouku⟧: idiom, idiomatic expression — the most common everyday term for fixed expressions
- ⟦{熟語|じゅくご}→熟語：04219_jukugo⟧: compound word, idiomatic phrase — often refers to two-, three-, or four-character kanji compounds
- ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧: four-character idiom — a specific subtype of {成語|せいご} / ⟦{熟語|じゅくご}→熟語：04219_jukugo⟧
- ことわざ: proverb, saying — refers specifically to pithy traditional sayings that teach a lesson
